class Point {
  x = 1;
  y: string = "";
  z?: number;
  constructor(public w: number) {}
}
interface Point {
  x: string;
  y: string;
  z: number;
  w: number;
  extra?: boolean;
}
interface Later {
  a: number;
}
class Later {
  a: string = "";
}
class Mod {
  readonly r = 1;
}
interface Mod {
  r: number;
}
